_comment: App Store frame copy. `frames` sets the upload order and which captured screen each wraps (sources are NN_<Shot case>.png; the NN follows the order of `Shot` in BookGate/Shots/ShotCatalog.swift). A span in *asterisks* renders in brass — mark the phrase carrying the benefit, not a fixed word, so each language accents what matters in that language.
_placeholder_copy: PLACEHOLDER: replace once the ASO keyword analysis lands.
_excluded_for_now: 07_gate is captured but not uploaded until a stand-in photo exists at Scripts/shot-assets/gate.jpg (the Simulator has no camera, so the frame is black). 10_paywall is captured but not uploaded until StoreKit resolves real prices — outside Xcode's Run action it correctly shows its 'prices unavailable' state.

en: An alarm for *the book* you're reading
One time, every night. Tonight at 9:00.
Swipe the sky. The alarm follows.
Your apps *stay shut* while you read
Twenty quiet minutes, then everything comes back.
Thirty seconds after reading. Kept on your phone.
The night closes when *you* close it
No pages counted. No streak nagging.
A year of reading, at a glance.
